issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the problem statement text instructs students to implement singFarmSongVerse(Animal) as public for easier testing, while the UML in the same problem statement shows the method as private (prefixed with '-'). Both the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) declare the method as private. This contradicting guidance (text vs UML) and the private implementation in the code can confuse students and test authors about whether tests may access this helper directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility inconsistency by choosing one clear authoritative design and updating all artifacts: Option A (make helper accessible to tests): change the helper signature to public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) in the template and solution Farm.java files and update the UML in problem_statement.md to mark the method as public. Option B (keep helper private): remove or reword the sentence in problem_statement.md that instructs students to make singFarmSongVerse public, clarifying that tests will not call the helper directly and that it may remain private. Also update any test specifications or instructor notes to match the chosen option.
